The '''assault proton torpedo''' was a capital ship grade [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] for use by and against [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. They were more powerful than the standard [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] and commonly used aboard [[MC30c Torpedo Frigate]].
